blocks.translation: ● This product is for ages 15+. Do not give it to children under the recommended age. It contains small parts and batteries; take care that small children do not accidentally swallow them, as there is a risk of choking or other hazards. Do not use near the ear; misuse may damage hearing. This product contains electronic components; users with pacemakers should exercise caution. ● Do not insert fingers or other objects into gaps of moving parts; they may become caught and cause injury. Do not play roughly by striking, swinging, etc. Do not stare at flashing LED lights for extended periods; this may cause nausea or other discomfort. 《Improper use of batteries may cause overheating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following》 ● If battery fluid gets into your eyes, immediately rinse with plenty of water and consult a physician. If leaked fluid gets on skin or clothing, wash with water. Button batteries are dangerous if swallowed; keep out of the reach of children. Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries. ● Insert batteries with the correct plus (+) and minus (−) orientation. Do not short-circuit, attempt to recharge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire. When disposing of batteries or the product, follow your local municipality's disposal instructions.

blocks.translation: <Precautions for Use> ● This product is precision-made. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage. ● This product contains precision electronic components. Do not drop, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in locations that become very hot or very cold. ● Do not place this product on resin sofas, seats, tiles, etc. — prolonged contact may cause color transfer. ● Do not forcefully pull, bend, or twist movable parts or attachment points in unnatural directions. ● Some spoken sounds may have different intonation or be difficult to hear due to the product's characteristics; please understand this in advance. Due to the nature of the product, appearance may vary. ● If a Lockseed malfunctions, remove the button battery, press the rear button, then reinsert the button battery.

Failed transformation play with the Oren Lockseed
Attach the Gridon Faceplate to the Sengoku Driver (sold separately). While in the pre-transformation state, press and hold both the BGM Button and the Sound Effect Button simultaneously, and let the "lock switching" sound play four times in succession.
The Driver will transition to the "Oren transformation standby sound" state.

blocks.text:
※グリドンフェイスプレートでのみ、
この状態に移行可能です。
blocks.translation: * This state can only be entered with the Gridon Faceplate.

blocks.text:
凰蓮ロックシードの開錠ボタンを押し、ハンガーを開錠します。
→「開錠音」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
Press the unlock button on the Oren Lockseed to open the hanger.
→ The "unlocking" sound will play.

blocks.text:
ロックシードをセットし、ハンガーを押し込みます。
→「装着音」が鳴り、 「凰蓮変身待機音」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
Insert the Lockseed and push the hanger in.
→ The "attachment" sound will play, followed by the "Oren transformation standby sound."

blocks.text:
① 「凰蓮変身待機音」 が鳴っている間に 「効果音ボタン」を押します。
→「変身待機音」が停止します。
②手動で凰蓮ロックシードのフタを開きます。
「凰蓮偽変身音」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
① While the "Oren transformation standby sound" is playing, press the Sound Effect Button.
→ The "transformation standby" sound will stop.
② Manually open the lid of the Oren Lockseed.
→ The "Oren fake transformation" sound will play.

blocks.text:
恥を知りなさーい!
ネバーギーブアーップ!
blocks.translation:
Have some shame!
Never give up!

blocks.text:
※戦極ドライバーのブレードでカットしても
「凰蓮偽変身音」が鳴ります。
※凰蓮ロックシードには必殺技音は
blocks.translation:
* Even if cut with the Sengoku Driver's blade, the "Oren fake transformation" sound will play.
* The Oren Lockseed does not have a finisher sound.
